AgreementOut.description:
Three-level agreement of the judge's correctness with the answer
level (method v0.3) over ``n`` judged repeats, and the linearly
weighted kappa; None where it is undefined.
AgreementOut.title: AgreementOut

AgreementSplitOut.description: Agreement over the answers that answered and those that abstained.
AgreementSplitOut.title: AgreementSplitOut

AnswerLevelAgreementOut.description: Each judge's agreement with the answer level, as the run reports the first judge's.
AnswerLevelAgreementOut.title: AnswerLevelAgreementOut

ApiErrorBody.description: The error object every failure carries (docs/reference/07 section 11).
ApiErrorBody.title: ApiErrorBody

BenchmarkJob.description:
A benchmark job (POST /api/v1/benchmarks, GET /benchmarks/jobs/{job_id}).

``run_id`` names the published run once the job completed; ``progress``
is None until the first world reaches its first instance; ``error`` is
the curated envelope of a failed job.
BenchmarkJob.title: BenchmarkJob

BenchmarkRunOut.description:
One published run in GET /api/v1/benchmarks, from its ``summary.json``:
``selection`` is the part of the bank it scored, ``worlds`` its seeds,
``method_version`` the method it was made under.
BenchmarkRunOut.title: BenchmarkRunOut

BenchmarkStart.description:
Request for POST /api/v1/benchmarks; the seeds, strata and kind are
checked against the harness's own before a job starts. A dev run uses
seed 2026 only; a full-bank official run uses the unseen seeds, which
the API never accepts (D-091), so an official job covers part of the
bank on a seen seed, as the dry run does.
BenchmarkStart.title: BenchmarkStart

BenchmarkSummary.description:
Response for GET /api/v1/benchmarks/latest and /benchmarks/{run_id}.

``summary`` is the run's ``summary.json``, typed: the only benchmark
source the API publishes. ``run_kind`` and ``label`` are copied out of
it so a client can tell a smoke or sweep run from an official result
without reading the summary. ``method_version`` is the method the run was
made under, from its record; only runs of the current method are
published (D-104).
BenchmarkSummary.title: BenchmarkSummary

BetweenJudgesCellOut.description:
Correctness of the first judge against the second; ``confusion[i][j]``
counts repeats the first judge put on level i and the second on level j.
BetweenJudgesCellOut.title: BetweenJudgesCellOut

Check.description:
One readiness check: whether it passed and a curated detail, never a
service address or raw driver or provider text.

stand_in.description: True when an offline stand-in for testing (the fake generator or the hashing embedder) passed the check in place of a real model, so the screens can say that answers are not a real model's.
stand_in.title: Stand In

Check.title: Check

Citation.description: A citation rendered under an answer; every citation is inspectable.

record_table.description: Source table of a record block or graph node; None for documents
record_table.title: Record Table

Citation.title: Citation

ColumnOut.description: One column; ``description`` is None where the schema registry has none.
ColumnOut.title: ColumnOut

ComparisonCell.description:
One paired comparison of a stratum and metric: the mean difference with
its clustered 95 percent interval, and the test where one was run.
ComparisonCell.title: ComparisonCell

ConceptOut.description:
One ontology concept. ``labels`` and ``synonyms`` are keyed by
language, ``binding_counts`` by market id; codes shared by every market
(channels, incident types) count under ``shared``. ``relationships`` are
the relationship types the concept takes part in, derived from ingestion
(``IS_A`` with a parent or child, ``MAPS_TO`` with a bound code).
ConceptOut.title: ConceptOut

DataModelExample.description:
The incident the Data Model Overview follows through the three layers,
or null when the active world has none (no incidents, or no truth ledger
of its own to check against). Carries the example's id only: never which
rows were planted or why.
DataModelExample.title: DataModelExample

DatasetDetail.description:
Response for GET /datasets/{dataset_id}; ``index_status`` is None
when no persistent index was built over the world.
DatasetDetail.title: DatasetDetail

DatasetSummary.description:
One generated world as GET /datasets lists it; ``active`` marks the
world the lab serves (``DATASET_DIR``).
DatasetSummary.title: DatasetSummary

DemoQuestion.description:
A demo question: one instance of the presentation world's frozen bank.

Pipeline-visible fields only: the text every pipeline receives, never
the expected answer, checks or claims. ``market_scope`` is empty (all
markets): the bank defines no scope of its own.
DemoQuestion.title: DemoQuestion

EdgeSummary.description: How many relationships of one type meet a node in one direction.
EdgeSummary.title: EdgeSummary

Empty.description: Lifecycle events that carry no fields.
Empty.title: Empty

ErrorEnvelope.description: The body of every non-2xx response: ``{"error": {...}}``.
ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

ErrorPayload.description:
``pipeline.failed``, ``pipeline.cancelled``, ``run.failed`` and
``run.cancelled`` carry the docs/reference/07 section 11 error envelope.
ErrorPayload.title: ErrorPayload

EvidenceChunk.description: One retrieved chunk with its provenance and ranking outcome.

dense_rank.description: 1-based rank in the dense channel; None if absent or unknown
dense_rank.title: Dense Rank

discard_reason.description: Why the chunk was not selected: context_budget | duplicate | same_record (its row is already selected through the other channel)
discard_reason.title: Discard Reason

discovered_via.description: How the chunk entered the candidate set: vector | graph_traversal | vector+graph_traversal
discovered_via.title: Discovered Via

facts.description: A record's compact facts as (name, value), in prompt order
facts.title: Facts

facts_heading.description: Heading of a record's compact facts (Incident INC_024), for a record block and a graph node with one; None for documents and nodes without a record block
facts_heading.title: Facts Heading

graph_path.description: A graph node's walked path from its seed, one line (INC_1 -AFFECTS-> GAME_1); None for a seed and for documents
graph_path.title: Graph Path

graph_seed.description: The seed id a graph node's walked path starts at; set exactly when graph_path is
graph_seed.title: Graph Seed

kind.description: chunk (document text) | record (table row) | node (graph block)
kind.title: Kind

rank.description: 1-based position in its channel: cross-encoder order for chunks and records, graph relevance order for graph nodes
rank.title: Rank

record_table.description: Source table when kind is record, or of a graph node's authoritative row
record_table.title: Record Table

rerank_score.description: Cross-encoder score of a chunk or record; None for graph nodes
rerank_score.title: Rerank Score

similarity.description: Score within the candidate's channel: for chunks and records the fused reciprocal-rank score of the dense and sparse channels (not a cosine); for graph nodes the graph composite score
similarity.title: Similarity

sparse_rank.description: 1-based rank in the sparse channel; None if absent or unknown
sparse_rank.title: Sparse Rank

EvidenceChunk.title: EvidenceChunk

ExperimentSettings.description:
The settings a run records, as the system would record them now.

No secret and no git state.
ExperimentSettings.title: ExperimentSettings

FailuresOut.description:
Per pipeline: scored repeats, generation and judge failures, and the
repeats per failure class.
FailuresOut.title: FailuresOut

FirstJudgeOut.description:
The first judge as the run recorded it, and its reply limit (the
code's; absent in a summary written before it was recorded).
FirstJudgeOut.title: FirstJudgeOut

GraphCandidateReranked.description:
A document candidate's cross-encoder outcome (old-method runs also
re-ranked nodes, with ``kind`` "node").
GraphCandidateReranked.title: GraphCandidateReranked

GraphContextAssembled.description:
``stated_links`` counts the schema-stated links read among the reached
nodes for the target-type tier; None when none were read (the question
names no target type).
GraphContextAssembled.title: GraphContextAssembled

GraphEntityResolved.description:
A resolver match carries ``confidence``; a vector fallback seed has no
resolver confidence and carries ``fused_score`` instead.
GraphEntityResolved.title: GraphEntityResolved

GraphEvidence.description:
One graph node candidate with its transparent ranking outcome.

Structured nodes additionally carry authoritative facts read from the
warehouse Parquet layer (the graph guides, Parquet states facts).

authoritative.description: Authoritative structured-layer facts for this node
authoritative.title: Authoritative

graph_rank.description: 1-based position in the graph channel; None when refused before the order
graph_rank.title: Graph Rank

tier.description: Graph relevance tier; None for a node refused before the graph order
tier.title: Tier

GraphEvidence.title: GraphEvidence

GraphNodeDiscarded.description:
``tier`` and ``graph_rank`` are None only for a node refused before
the graph order (``out_of_scope_market``, ``excluded_label``).
GraphNodeDiscarded.title: GraphNodeDiscarded

GraphNodeSelected.description:
``tier`` and ``graph_rank`` place the node in the graph channel's
relevance order (D-083).
GraphNodeSelected.title: GraphNodeSelected

GraphRunResult.description: Complete record of one graph-enhanced execution (pipeline B or C).
GraphRunResult.title: GraphRunResult

GraphSchema.description:
Response for GET /graph/schema: the graph model and the traversal
settings pipelines B and C run with.
GraphSchema.title: GraphSchema

GraphStats.description:
Response for GET /graph/stats, read from the active dataset's
``_graph_stats.json``: what its ingestion pushed, not a live count.
GraphStats.title: GraphStats

GraphTargetTypesResolved.description:
The graph labels the question asks about, sorted and comma-joined; ""
when it names none (D-083).
GraphTargetTypesResolved.title: GraphTargetTypesResolved

IndexStatus.description: The vector index built over a world, from its index manifest.
IndexStatus.title: IndexStatus

InstanceCounts.description: Scored instances per stratum key and overall: in all, and per world seed.
InstanceCounts.title: InstanceCounts

InstancePipelineOut.description:
One pipeline's scores on one instance: each metric is the mean over its
successful repeats (None where none defines it), from the run's results.
InstancePipelineOut.title: InstancePipelineOut

InstanceResultOut.description:
One scored bank instance of a run (GET /api/v1/benchmarks/{run_id}/instances).

Carries the question and the scores only: never the expected answer,
the claims or checks, or any answer text.
InstanceResultOut.title: InstanceResultOut

JobProgress.description: The world a job is running and how far through its instances it is.
JobProgress.title: JobProgress

JudgeMeansOut.description: Each judge's mean of the five dimensions over ``n`` repeats both judged.
JudgeMeansOut.title: JudgeMeansOut

JudgesCountsOut.description:
Answers of the run, those both judges scored, those on which they gave
the same correctness, those with no mark by reason, and the answers the
judges disagree on.
JudgesCountsOut.title: JudgesCountsOut

JudgesDisagreeOut.description: One answer the judges disagree on: one gave correctness 2, the other 0.
JudgesDisagreeOut.title: JudgesDisagreeOut

JudgesMarkOut.description:
The two judges' combined mark (``combined.json``, schema 1, D-105):
per answer (c1 + c2) / 4, tested as its own family. ``metrics`` is per
stratum and pipeline, ``comparisons`` and ``headlines`` have the run's
shapes, ``agreement`` is between the judges.
JudgesMarkOut.title: JudgesMarkOut

LabelAgreementOut.description: The labelling analysis with the second judge added as ``second_judge``.
LabelAgreementOut.title: LabelAgreementOut

LabelMeasureOut.description:
One measure's agreement with the consensus labels; ``kappa_shown`` is
False below the item count a kappa is shown from.
LabelMeasureOut.title: LabelMeasureOut

LivePipelineScore.description:
One pipeline's deterministic scores on a live bank question; None
where the instance does not define the metric.

Method v0.3 scores evidence recall, the evidence metric it compares
(D-087). ``evidence_f1`` is set only in a score stored under method
v0.2, which had no recall; each is None in a score of the other method.
LivePipelineScore.title: LivePipelineScore

LiveScore.description:
A completed bank question's live answers scored against its answer
key by the deterministic scorers (never the judge, spec 10a.1).
LiveScore.title: LiveScore

MemberOut.description:
A local code bound to a concept; ``name`` is its local display name
when the term table has one.
MemberOut.title: MemberOut

MetricCell.description:
One pipeline's mean of one metric over a stratum: ``n`` instances,
``repeats`` scored repeats; the mean is None where no repeat defines it.
MetricCell.title: MetricCell

ModelOut.description:
One configured model. ``reachable`` is null for a model that runs in
process and has not been loaded.
ModelOut.title: ModelOut

ModelStarted.description:
Start of an embedding or generation stage (``rag.embedding.started``,
``rag.generation.started``, ``graph.generation.started``).
ModelStarted.title: ModelStarted

ModelsOut.description:
``judge`` is the benchmark judge model; null when none is configured
(the offline judge of a smoke run is not a model).
ModelsOut.title: ModelsOut

NeighbourOut.description: One relationship from the node and the node at its other end.
NeighbourOut.title: NeighbourOut

Neighbours.description:
Response for GET /graph/nodes/{node_id}/neighbours; ``truncated``
says the node has more neighbours than ``limit``.
Neighbours.title: Neighbours

NodeOut.description:
One graph node; ``provenance`` is None for a node no source table
maps to (PrizeType, BusinessConcept). ``edges`` counts the links meeting
the node, per type and direction; only the node route fills it, and the
nodes listed as neighbours carry none.
NodeOut.title: NodeOut

OldMethodGraphChunkDiscarded.description: Old method (v0.2) only: a discard with a reason of the slot rule.
OldMethodGraphChunkDiscarded.title: OldMethodGraphChunkDiscarded

OldMethodGraphContextAssembled.description: Old method (v0.2) only: it recorded its evidence-slot count.
OldMethodGraphContextAssembled.title: OldMethodGraphContextAssembled

OldMethodGraphNodeDiscarded.description: Old method (v0.2) only: nodes were re-ranked with the documents.
OldMethodGraphNodeDiscarded.title: OldMethodGraphNodeDiscarded

OldMethodGraphNodeSelected.description: Old method (v0.2) only: nodes were re-ranked with the documents.
OldMethodGraphNodeSelected.title: OldMethodGraphNodeSelected

OldMethodRagContextAssembled.description: Old method (v0.2) only: it recorded its evidence-slot count.
OldMethodRagContextAssembled.title: OldMethodRagContextAssembled

OldMethodRagEvidenceDiscarded.description: Old method (v0.2) only: a discard with a reason of the slot rule.
OldMethodRagEvidenceDiscarded.title: OldMethodRagEvidenceDiscarded

PipelineScore.description:
One pipeline's means over the scored repeats of one question; None
where no scored repeat defines the metric.
PipelineScore.title: PipelineScore

ProvenanceOut.description: The warehouse row a graph node was built from.
ProvenanceOut.title: ProvenanceOut

QueryAccepted.description: Response for POST /api/v1/queries: the run is queued for its worker.
QueryAccepted.title: QueryAccepted

QueryRequest.description:
Request for POST /api/v1/queries (docs/reference/07 section 4).

Unknown fields are refused, so a client still sending the retired
``profile`` gets a 422 rather than a silently ignored field.
QueryRequest.title: QueryRequest

QueryResults.description:
Response for GET /api/v1/queries/{run_id}: the summary plus every
stored pipeline result, readable as soon as each pipeline finishes.

``answer_key`` says whether the question has one: "none" for an ad hoc
question, which is never scored. ``score_status`` says where the score
stands: "not_applicable" for an ad hoc question and for a run that was
cancelled or failed, "pending" for a completed bank question until its
score is written (just after the final status), then "scored" with
``score`` set, or "failed" when scoring failed.
QueryResults.title: QueryResults

QuestionOut.description:
One bank question for the Help screen (GET /api/v1/benchmarks/questions).

``hidden_truth`` is the planted scenario's truth for H5 questions, else
None. ``scores`` are per pipeline from the chosen run, None when that run
did not score this question or no run exists.
QuestionOut.title: QuestionOut

RagAnswer.description:
Generated answer plus its cost and grounded citations.

`citations` lists every block shown to the model in prompt order (the
selection's order, whatever its kind), so
`cited_blocks[i]` refers to `citations[cited_blocks[i] - 1]`.

answer_form.description: How the parser read the output: json | repaired | unclosed | plain
answer_form.title: Answer Form

cited_blocks.description: 1-based context blocks the answer cites, in first-seen order
cited_blocks.title: Cited Blocks

cut_off.description: The answer stops before the model finished it: it stopped at the token limit, or its object never closed and the provider did not say whether it did
cut_off.title: Cut Off

finish_reason.description: The provider's stop reason as the gateway reported it
finish_reason.title: Finish Reason

max_tokens.description: The output token cap of the call; None for the fake model
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

surrogates_replaced.description: Lone UTF-16 surrogates replaced with U+FFFD in the raw text, verdict and answer; None in an answer recorded before answer parser 2.1.1
surrogates_replaced.title: Surrogates Replaced

text.description: Parsed prose answer; what the evaluator scores
text.title: Text

token_limit_reached.description: Whether the output stopped at max_tokens: the stop reason is 'length' or the completion token count reached the cap; None when the provider reports neither
token_limit_reached.title: Token Limit Reached

usage.description: Gateway token counts when the provider reports them
usage.title: Usage

verdict.description: One-line verdict; empty when the model gave none
verdict.title: Verdict

RagAnswer.title: RagAnswer

RagRunResult.description: Complete record of one standard RAG execution.
RagRunResult.title: RagRunResult

Readiness.description: Response for GET /api/v1/health/ready: 200 when ready, else 503.
Readiness.title: Readiness

RecordOut.description:
One warehouse row and the graph node it maps to.

``graph_node_id`` is the id ingestion gives the row's node
(``app.graph.node_rows.NODE_TABLES``); None with ``edges`` empty when the
table creates no nodes. For a world the graph does not hold, ``edges``
is None and ``graph_error`` is ``OTHER_WORLD``; when the graph cannot be
read, the node id is kept, ``edges`` is None and ``graph_error`` is
``GRAPH_QUERY_ERROR``.
RecordOut.title: RecordOut

RecordedEvent.description:
One execution event: the envelope shared by replay and the stream
(docs/reference/07 section 6). ``pipeline`` is ``run`` for run lifecycle events.
RecordedEvent.title: RecordedEvent

RelTypeOut.description: One relationship type between the labels it joins.
RelTypeOut.title: RelTypeOut

ReproducibilityOut.description:
What the run and each world recorded. Mappings, not models: older runs
lack fields, and the Results screen shows unknown keys by name.
ReproducibilityOut.title: ReproducibilityOut

RowPage.description:
One page of sample rows, ordered by the primary key; ``total`` counts
every row matching the same filter.
RowPage.title: RowPage

RunHistory.description:
Response for GET /api/v1/queries: newest first; ``next_before`` is the
``before`` value of the next page, or None on the last page.
RunHistory.title: RunHistory

RunSummary.description: One run as history lists it, and the response of POST .../cancel.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

ScenarioOut.description:
A catalogue scenario and whether the active dataset planted it. Carries
configuration only: never the truth ledger. ``description`` is the
catalogue's plain description of the story, which is configuration, not
truth.
ScenarioOut.title: ScenarioOut

SecondJudgeCountsOut.description:
Repeats to judge, those judged, failures by kind and by message,
repeats not yet judged, and replies that stopped at the reply cap.
SecondJudgeCountsOut.title: SecondJudgeCountsOut

SecondJudgeLabelsOut.description: The second judge over the hand-labelled sample, beside the first judge.
SecondJudgeLabelsOut.title: SecondJudgeLabelsOut

SecondJudgeModelOut.description: The second judge model and the settings it was called with.
SecondJudgeModelOut.title: SecondJudgeModelOut

SecondJudgeOut.description:
Response for GET /api/v1/benchmarks/{run_id}/second-judge: the newest
second-judge summary of the run and, when there is one, the newest label
check of the same model (D-100), and the two judges' combined mark when it
has been computed from that summary's pass (D-105), else null.
SecondJudgeOut.title: SecondJudgeOut

SecondJudgeRunOut.description: The second judge over one run.
SecondJudgeRunOut.title: SecondJudgeRunOut

SelectionOut.description: The part of the bank a run scored.
SelectionOut.title: SelectionOut

SplitCell.description:
A cell of the ontology-dependent split: a comparison of B and C
over one group of instances, never tested (``in_family`` is false).
SplitCell.title: SplitCell

SummaryOut.description:
A run's ``summary.json``, schema 3, the keys the clients read.

A key added later is ignored, so an older client keeps reading.
SummaryOut.title: SummaryOut

TableProvenance.description: Where a table's rows come from, as the world's manifest records it.
TableProvenance.title: TableProvenance

TableSchemaOut.description: One table of the data dictionary (GET /datasets/{dataset_id}/dictionary).
TableSchemaOut.title: TableSchemaOut

UnavailableOut.description: A bank question the world could not ground, and why.
UnavailableOut.title: UnavailableOut

Request the job to stop before its next instance; the instance in
progress finishes first, so the job stays running until then.

Response List Datasets Api V1 Datasets Get
Response Read Dictionary Api V1 Datasets  Dataset Id  Dictionary Get

schema.title: Response Read Demo Questions Api V1 Demo Questions Get

get.description: Liveness probe used by CI, Docker and the frontend.
Readiness: the lab, the index, Neo4j and the model provider.

schema.title: Response Read Members Api V1 Ontology Concepts  Concept Id  Members Get

get.description:
The run's events as server-sent events: every stored event after
the resume point, then each new one, closing after the terminal event.
